title: Pluto Security raises $42M as AI gives enterprise security teams a new headache
slides: Pluto Security just raised $42M — but why now?
AI tools are creating unforeseen security gaps in enterprises.
The threat isn't hackers — it's your own AI agents.
Audit every AI tool your team uses this week.
Your security stack wasn't built for this. What will you change?
thread_text:
1. $42M for AI Security

Pluto Security just raised that. Investors don't write checks that size unless enterprises are already bleeding. The breach isn't coming — it's happening inside your own tools.

2. AI Tools Open Backdoors

Every plugin, agent and integration your team adopted this year expanded the attack surface. Nobody audited them. That's the gap.

3. Your Agents Are the Threat

The danger isn't an external hacker. It's the AI agent your team gave permissions to. It can leak, delete, or act without anyone noticing.

4. Audit This Week

List every AI tool your team touches. Check what data it can access, who approved it, and what it can do without asking. Most teams fail step one.

5. Your Stack Wasn't Built

For agents that act on their own. So what will you change first — permissions, tools, or the people clicking approve?
